english.title: Conspire to commit either way offence outside England and Wales in relation to theft and kindred offences
english.standardoffencewording:

(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1, 1A and 3 of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired with one or more persons
to commit an offence of theft or a kindred offence
outside England and Wales

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence should only be used where the conspiracy is to commit theft and kindred offences OUTSIDE OF England and Wales.
(ii) Section 1A of the Criminal Law Act 1977, as amended by section 72 of the Coroners and Justice Act 2009, provides conditions in relation to this offence.
(iii) Section 1 of the Criminal Law Act 1977 provides the offence of conspiracy. The ingredients of the statutory offence of conspiracy were set out at length in R v Saik 2006.

other.penalty:
Penalty is the same as for the relevant substantive offence.

If the relevant offence carries a fine only, then an unlimited fine may be imposed.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None
